title: Engineering for McCartney Road Improvements (Trekell to I-10)
short_description: Engineering and surveying services for roadway improvements along McCartney Road in Casa Grande.
project_scope: Roadway improvements along McCartney Road from Trekell Road to Interstate 10 in Casa Grande, Arizona. The notice indicates a corridor-based streets/highways project but provides no technical parameters such as length, lane configuration, bridge structures, drainage quantities, or construction limits beyond the stated segment.
services: Professional engineering and surveying services, including civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, structural engineering, utility engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a roadway improvement project in the streets/highways sector.
- Includes structural engineering, but no bridge, long-span, special structure, or architecturally demanding element is described.
- Scope appears focused on multidisciplinary corridor engineering rather than specialized structural design.
- Could offer limited relevance if structures are involved, but the notice provides no evidence of significant structural complexity.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the notice, and the available project information is too limited for a realistic fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Bidders are asked to submit Statements of Qualifications for professional engineering and surveying services. Specific minimum reference counts, qualification thresholds, or comparable-project requirements are not stated in the notice excerpt.
